records.topic: Current official agricultural weather/advisory service role and access conditions
records.required_primary_source_type: Official IMD/TNAU service or documentation page
records.reason: High-impact because weather/advisory data may shape farmer decisions.
records.allowed_conclusion: Label a named public service and its stated scope/current access conditions; do not infer recommendation quality.

records.topic: Current Namakkal agriculture department information and district-level local context
records.required_primary_source_type: Official Namakkal/Tamil Nadu government publication or department page
records.reason: High-impact local context must not rest on historical research notes.
records.allowed_conclusion: Verify only what an official current/dates source states.

records.topic: Current agricultural market-price information service and semantic scope
records.reason: Price data can be misconstrued without commodity, market, grade, unit, timing, and update semantics.
records.allowed_conclusion: Confirm source availability and stated fields; do not claim price prediction or farmer benefit.

records.topic: High-impact global/national agricultural statistics retained in historical problem syntheses
records.required_primary_source_type: Named primary institutional or peer-reviewed source for each statistic
records.reason: Repeated historical synthesis claims must not be source-laundered.
records.allowed_conclusion: Revalidate individual claims only with precise scope, year, and method.

records.topic: Historical stack, sensor, AI, and automation claims
records.required_primary_source_type: Current engineering review, vendor documentation, safety analysis, and controlled test evidence
records.reason: Historical technical descriptions are not current feasibility proof.
records.allowed_conclusion: State feasibility only at the reviewed component/system/test scope.
